identity.rule: every arm of every declared problem equals the protected driver run with reference finite differences in: success, stop_reason, attempts, accepted_steps, rejected_steps, jacobian_reuses, t_end_bits, final_fingerprint, state_fingerprint, jacobian_fingerprint, builds, jacobian_builds, direct_factorizations, direct_solve_calls

rhs_calls.rule: assembly calls = builds * (colours + 1) on the coloured route and builds * (n + 1) on the dense route; check calls as declared (8 columns on first use, plus the base evaluation with threads; none on the sequential dense route); in the identity pass also: run counters = callback count = stage calls of the protected run + assembly + checks

fail_closed.rule: every negative control ends with InvalidInput, a typed contract error, no completed build and no accepted step, and the direct full check fails too

controls.control: 1 omitted coupling reaches a row its colour does not cover
1 omitted coupling reaches a row its colour does not cover
2 omitted coupling aliased into a declared entry
2 omitted coupling aliased into a declared entry
3 right-hand side that is not a function of its input
3 right-hand side that is not a function of its input
4 full check requested with the aliased pattern
counter-example: the aliased pattern without check columns is not noticed
positive control: the true ring pattern with a full check

wall.node_rule: PASS only if every qualifying problem (rhs_cost rule) has cell PASS; KILL only if every qualifying problem has cell KILL; otherwise FAIL with the per-cell table (the regime where the lever pays). Controls never enter the verdict.
wall.cell_rule: for a qualifying problem: best = max over P in {2, 4, 6} of the whole-solve speed-up among authoritative ratios. Cell PASS if best >= 1.5; cell KILL if the speed-up is < 1.1 at every P in {2, 4, 6}; otherwise cell FAIL (between). If no ratio of the cell is authoritative: NOT_DECIDABLE, with the diagnostic numbers.
wall.quality_rule: a cell is authoritative only if the 1-minute load average is at most 8 before and after and (max - min) / median over the 7 repetitions is at most 0.10 in the seq arm and in the tP arm of the ratio in question; a cell that misses may be measured again at most twice; every measurement is kept; the verdict uses the first measurement that meets the rule; otherwise the ratio is diagnostic_only
